note: Cron consolidation RANK 3 (health tick). One row per absorbed crontab line, read verbatim from `crontab -l` on 2026-10-07 (line numbers in `note`). Schedule fields are cron-equivalent: a step is due at a tick when the tick minute satisfies (minute - minute_offset) % cadence_minutes == 0 for sub-hour cadences, or minute == minute_offset snapped to the tick grid and the hour satisfies `hours` (explicit list) or hour % (cadence_minutes/60) == 0 (null) for hour-and-up cadences. `weekdays` are ISO numbers 1=Mon..7=Sun, identical to cron 1-5 for Mon-Fri. `lock` is the /tmp flock path the cron line used; a lock the cron line did NOT have is named /tmp/health_tick_<step>.lock and marked in the note. `needs_env` is false everywhere because no absorbed line sourced anything: each script loads CURRENT/.env itself (CURRENT/.env is a symlink to the dev-tree .env). `log` is the `>> logs/...` target the cron line appended to; health_tick appends the step's stdout+stderr there so log-freshness monitors (system_health_agent) keep seeing the same files. The three safety nets (portfolio_server_watchdog.sh, process_reaper.py, cleanup_stale_locks.sh), resolve_due_checkpoints.py and the @reboot moomoo line stay in cron on purpose.
